csv_conventions.floats: shortest round-trip decimal representation (parses to the identical binary64 value)
csv_conventions.unavailable: empty cell; the row's `reason` column states why. Zero is never a placeholder.
csv_conventions.times: UTC ISO 8601 with a trailing Z; offsets in seconds from the first canonical sample

mean_spectrum.title: Mean H/V spectrum
mean_spectrum.row: one selection (method / peak family) at one frequency of the analysis grid
mean_spectrum.description: Selected-window geometric-mean H/V with the single nominal 95% pointwise band ('Estimated 95% pointwise CI for the selected-window mean'), exactly as in the analysis JSON `selections[].mean_curve`. The band is selection-conditional and its coverage is not calibrated unless the analysis JSON `calibration.status` says otherwise.

columns.name: selection_id
columns.description: Selection identifier, as in the analysis JSON.

columns.name: peak_family_id
columns.description: Peak family of the selection; empty when there is none.

columns.name: frequency_hz
columns.description: Frequency of the anchored logarithmic analysis grid.

columns.name: hv_geometric_mean
columns.description: Geometric mean of the selected windows' H/V (ln-amplitude average).

columns.name: ci95_lower
columns.description: Lower bound of the Estimated 95% pointwise CI for the selected-window mean.

columns.name: ci95_upper
columns.description: Upper bound of the Estimated 95% pointwise CI for the selected-window mean.

columns.name: count
columns.description: Selected windows valid at this frequency.

columns.name: log_std
columns.description: Sample standard deviation of ln H/V across the selected windows (dispersion, not the CI).

columns.name: frequency_valid
columns.description: The analysis grid is valid at this frequency.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Row status.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why each empty numeric cell in this row is unavailable ('column: reason', separated by ' | '). Empty when every value is present.

window_table_standard.title: Per-window table, Standard method
window_table_standard.row: one candidate window of one Standard selection (every candidate, selected or not)
window_table_standard.description: Candidate windows with basic-QC result and the Standard rule outcome (earliest-first non-overlapping windows; optional FDWRA).

window_table_sdof.description: Peak-aligned SDOF template matching (R2_log on the 129-point ln-q grid), eligibility, ranking, and greedy non-overlapping selection inside each plausible peak family.

window_spectra.description: Smoothed H/V of every candidate window (selected or not) at the frequencies where the analysis grid is valid (the full grid and its validity are in the analysis JSON). Regenerated deterministically from the stored recording and the run configuration.

normalized_waveform.title: Normalized waveform
normalized_waveform.row: one sample instant (gaps appear as jumps in sample_index; nothing is interpolated)
normalized_waveform.description: Three-component samples exactly as parsed (integers for integer data, shortest round-trip decimals for floating data). Readable without decoding MiniSEED.

columns.name: sample_index
columns.description: Index from the first canonical sample.

columns.name: time_offset_s
columns.description: sample_index divided by the sampling rate.

columns.name: time_utc
columns.description: Absolute sample time (nanosecond digits). Present only when the recording has an absolute start time.
